watch.summary: The creator watches in awe as pro Valorant player Vora lands a lightning-fast flick headshot to secure a round win.

beats.what: Caster commentates as Vora holds an angle in a Valorant match.
Vora rapidly flicks onto an enemy player who peaks.
The headshot kill lands instantly to secure the round win.
The creator reacts with quiet disbelief, saying 'oh man'.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: This clip showcases impressive mechanical skill from a professional player rather than comedic content. The creator offers a brief, impressed reaction to the high-level gameplay.
